action_items: Fix GET /api/checkout/status/{session_id} — emergentintegrations lib fails Pydantic validation on Stripe metadata (StripeObject vs dict). Likely fixes: (a) upgrade emergentintegrations, (b) coerce metadata to dict before returning, or (c) call stripe.checkout.Session.retrieve directly and build the response manually. Frontend redirect flow works; only the status polling endpoint is affected — success/cancel page will error.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 2000+ lines — should be split (operator, ati routing, checkout, signals) for maintainability
GET /api/checkout/status/{session_id} lacks defensive try/except — currently returns raw 500 to client; wrap and return a friendly 502/503 if upstream lib fails
GPay FAB (fixed bottom-right) collides with the Emergent preview badge; not an app bug but a UX collision in preview environment — testing needed force=True or badge hide
Test test_signal_engine.py::test_generate_test_signal returns a value instead of using assert — pytest warning

Live Terminal Chart shows non-zero live price via WS (TV iframe canvas blank in headless is expected per user note).
rca of the issue: /api/checkout/status/{session_id} 500: emergentintegrations/payments/stripe/checkout.py:204 raises CheckoutError because CheckoutStatusResponse Pydantic model requires metadata: dict but Stripe returned a StripeObject. Reproduction: POST /api/checkout/create then GET /api/checkout/status/<session_id> — instant 500. Mitigation options in action_items.
